notes.title: Play Lost Eclipse Investigation Demo in Limited Time Only!
notes.content: [h1]Hi, all, Habi Kun Dev here,[/h1][p][/p][h3]First of all, we'd like to appreciate for your time and experience when playing our game, Lost Eclipse, and we listened to your feedback, some of them will be our priority for the development. We really can't thank you enough, so we hope you enjoy to what we offer you with the game. [/h3][p][/p][h2]Alright, so what's this all about?[/h2][h3]We're launching a limited time of new demo which will cover some:[/h3][olist][*][p]New story extend[/p][/*][*][p]New boss fight for chapter 1[/p][/*][*][p]New maze and puzzle [/p][/*][*][p]New evidence to collect[/p][/*][*][p]Some game optimization[/p][/*][*][p]New setting to disable screen blinking[/p][/*][*][p]New visuals[/p][/*][*][p]You can set game UI size by pressing Tab on keyboard / LT on Xbox / L2 on DS4-5 to make you comfortable[/p][/*][/olist][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45686985/b872f86ca011525bbd23302ad28a0a74d97c0091.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]The game will be available only until [b]September 30th[/b]! Be sure you have tried the game before the demo closes! [/h3][p][/p][h2]And once again, STAY CURIOUS! ːsteamhappyː[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45686985/e7964675b9d5689cddcff47ecf5ea9d2410cd168.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Lost Eclipse - Investigation Demo is out now!!
notes.content: [h1]"The truth is not what you see. The truth is something that you can prove"[/h1][p][/p][p]Hi, there, Habi Kun Dev here. The demo is finally out now that you can try by yourself with your beloved PC! You'll get the taste of horror retro vibes.[/p][p][/p][p]What you'll get in this demo?[/p][list][*][p]Chapter 1[/p][/*][*][p]Chapter 2[/p][/*][*][p]Chapter 3 (intro only)[/p][/*][*][p]New weapon that you can choose[/p][/*][*][p]New level exploration[/p][/*][*][p]New evidence or strange phenomenon need to be uncovered[/p][/*][*][p]New character (Kayla) that you can switch while game progressing.[/p][/*][/list][p]If you like the demo, feel free to give us the comments, and wishlist the full game![/p][p]Habi Kun Dev, sign out![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45686985/e7964675b9d5689cddcff47ecf5ea9d2410cd168.png"][/img][/p]
